comments.text:
Indian here. I can answer your question about why Indians want to save money and then leave. Most Indians want to actually settle in the US if they could. The H1B visa however needs to be renewed like every other year and there's a very high chance it won't be. So people have to leave even if they don't want to. Those that are practical don't plan a long term future in the US simply because of this very reason.

Of course there are those who game the system and remain on student visas while working all kinds of jobs and not pay taxes, but for the rest of us, living long term is not an option.

Also there's many of us who don't intend to become Americans, but go where our jobs take us and move from country to country.

All that said, there are many who manage to become US citizens but they always have one foot in India and they'll eventually go and retire in India because the money they earned in the US has much more purchasing power in India than in the US.

Personally I'd say respect the country you are in, pay your taxes, support local businesses even if things cost more. Recognise that the country gave you the opportunity to make all that money and just dumping all of it in India means you are draining the economy, or in other words killing the goose that lays golden eggs.
